purpose: Canonical website-facing map of the stock research system, including active connections, exploratory components, intentionally protected evidence, and missing or unused components.

status_definitions.active: Connected to the current evidence or publication flow.
status_definitions.exploratory: Implemented or tested, but not confirmatory or promoted.
status_definitions.unused: Missing, blocked, disabled, or disconnected from the current candidate.
status_definitions.protected: Intentionally excluded from exploration to preserve future confirmation.
